observations.why: Imperative directive issued without justification or consultation — authority of position exercised as a command to suppress prior knowledge, carrying an implicit cost of non-compliance.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration.

observations.why: Bare imperative commanding erasure of institutional knowledge — positional authority asserted without rationale or invitation, the absoluteness of 'all knowledge' intensifying the coercive register.
